description.long: Developed and industrialized a **real-time ETL pipeline** using **Scala and Spark**, organized in a **medallion architecture**. Optimized IoT data acquisition. Implemented a **hexagonal architecture** to separate business logic from interfaces. Increased test coverage from **55% to 75%**. Initiated cloud migration with **Databricks and PySpark**.

Integrated the **Keycloak** IAM authentication service in Java. Implemented **SSO** and secured **OIDC** flows via **JWT** token signing and encryption. Automated deployment using **Docker** and PowerShell.
Designed and developed a web application for monitoring university internships. Built with **Laravel**, **React** and **Material Design**. Containerized deployment using **Docker**.

Developed modules for a biostatistics platform, including a satisfaction survey tool, an internal forum, and a meeting agenda manager. Implemented **MVC architecture** using **PHP** and **CodeIgniter**.
